name: Spark Dwell Time
description: The time the spark coil is charged with energy (longer = stronger spark)                         The ECU calculates this based on battery voltage and speed.

name: Spark Adv Measured
description: The ECU tries to match the Spark Advance Target.                         Measured in Crank Angle = degrees Before Top Dead Center (BTDC)

name: MAP Read Angle
description: The crankshaft angle at which the MAP sensor is read once per engine cycle.                         Measured in Crank Angle = degrees Before Top Dead Center (BTDC).                         To get a measurement representative of load.                         It must be measured at the minimum value associated with the propagating vacuum pulse.

name: Air-Fuel Ratio Measured
description: Input from the fuel trims, oxygen sensor etc.                         The ECU tries to match the Air-Fuel Ratio Target.                         This value should be near to Air-Fuel Ratio Target.                         The perfect stoichiometric air-fuel ratio (AFR) is 14.7:1

name: Volume Efficiency Cyl 1
description: Describes the amount of fuel/air in the cylinder in relation to regular atmospheric air.                         If the cylinder is filled with fuel/air at atmospheric pressure, then the engine is said to have 100% volumetric efficiency.                         Normally aspirated engines typically run anywhere between 80% and 100% VE.                         The value comes from the calibration tables in the ECU.

name: Volume Efficiency Cyl 2
description: Describes the amount of fuel/air in the cylinder in relation to regular atmospheric air.                         If the cylinder is filled with fuel/air at atmospheric pressure, then the engine is said to have 100% volumetric efficiency.                         Normally aspirated engines typically run anywhere between 80% and 100% VE.                         The value comes from the calibration tables in the ECU.

name: IACV Position Target
description: Idle Air Control Valve (stepper motor) desired pintle position, controls the amount of air that enters the engine while the throttle is released.                         IMPORTANT: Any problem with cranking/idle speed: Read the appendix about the IACV in the help file.

name: Fuel Pump Duty Cycle
description: Defines the speed with which the fuel pump motor is running.

name: Test Spark (MT05.2 only)
description: This test creates a continuous spark in the spark plugs.                         The engine must not be running to execute this test.

name: Test Inject (MT05.2 only)
description: This test opens the fuel injectors.                         The engine must not be running to execute this test.

name: Test IACV (MT05.2 only)
description: This test moves the Idle Air Control Valve stepper motor to the minimum, maximum and parking position in an endless loop until you turn it off.                         The engine must not be running to execute this test.

name: Test Pump (MT05.2 only)
description: This test turns on the fuel pump.                         The engine must not be running to execute this test.
